feeds.title: Canterbury Basketball News
feeds.description: The Canterbury Basketball Association Inc. is a not-for-profit sporting organization established in 1972 to foster the growth, development, and promotion of basketball in Canterbury, New Zealand. It manages a comprehensive junior development program and participates fully in all Basketball New Zealand age group events. Run through the blog to catch up with the latest news, previews, league highlights, and more.

feeds.title: Franklin Bulls Basketball News
feeds.description: The Franklin Bulls are a basketball club that competes in the NZ SalsNBL. The blog offers the latest news on teams and players and information on tickets to basketball.

feeds.title: Auckland Tuatara
feeds.description: The Auckland Tuatara entered the Australian Baseball League in season 2018-19, playing three series in a pop-up stadium before moving into North Harbour Stadium for the 2019-20 ABL season. The organization acquired Sal's NBL license previously held by the Auckland Huskies in late 2021 and will make their basketball debut appearance this season, playing out of Eventfinda Stadium on Auckland's North Shore. Get all the latest news updates about the team.

feeds.title: Tauihi Basketball Aotearoa
feeds.description: Tauihi Basketball Aotearoa is set to change the face of women's basketball in New Zealand; it is a unique competition that inspires the next generation of young Kiwi women to aim higher - both on and off the court. Stay updated on news, schedule, stats, and more.

feeds.title: National Basketball League News
feeds.description: The National Basketball League (NBL) is the pre-eminent men's basketball league in New Zealand. Over the history of the league the league there have been a number of different teams participating - many of which became and remain iconic reminders of the NBL's proud history. The blog offers updates on NBL.

feeds.title: Southland Sharks News
feeds.description: Southland boasts a proud history with the game of basketball and after years of vision, dedication, and hard work it all finally paid off as the SIT Zero Fees Southland Sharks joined the New Zealand National Basketball League for the first time in 2010. The blog offers the latest news, articles, game analysis, match highlights, and more.

feeds.title: Canterbury Rams
feeds.description: The Canterbury Rams is an iconic brand that brings with it great memories for the Canterbury basketball and wider sporting community. Its vision is to contribute significantly to the growth of basketball throughout the region with a highly performing and well-run elite team greatly enhancing the profile and popularity of basketball. Get the latest news, videos, and photos.

feeds.title: BNZ Nothern Kāhu Blog
feeds.description: BNZ Nothern Kahu is a website offering insights into the team, players, partners, news, and more. The blog offers news, stats, analysis, and more to readers interested in basketball.

feeds.title: Lacey Lowdown
feeds.description: Lacey Lowdown is a basketball correspondent for Basketball New Zealand, Eurobasket.com, and a big fan and statistician of the New Zealand Breakers, she follows all aspects of New Zealand basketball. The blog offers all things New Zealand basketball.

feeds.title: College Sport Media » Basketball
feeds.description: The website provides news, articles, videos, and more on basketball. College Sports Media specializes in telling the story of successful young people. It wants to support the power of sport to have a positive influence on the lives of Kiwi kids and recognize this by promoting success within their community.

feeds.title: Basketball Otago News
feeds.description: Basketball Otago runs representative, competitive, and social Basketball leagues in Dunedin. They cover news surrounding the game and the region along with several competitions, club leagues, provides development resources, and more.
